data.subject: Local Ledger for Petiole
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for the period ending June 30, 2026, shows positions in CBAN and CBK.

A recent CBAN filing disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing on September 17, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/711669/000110465926108432/cban-20260917x8k.htm).

Would you like the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
